_comment: Conservative form defaults — privacy-safe answers used ONLY when no profile answer exists and the widget is a boolean/consent control (see resolve.py Step 6). Answer VALUES live here in data, never in code (ETHOS: no hardcoded answers). Each entry: {pattern, value, kinds}. kinds limits the field types the default may apply to.

defaults.pattern: receive alerts|job alerts|similar jobs|email me|notify me

defaults.note: the checked-state value a consent checkbox receives when JI_AUTO_CONSENT=1 (consumed by fill_runner, not Step 6)
